lieu: living room in Koumassi, Abidjan, a grandmother on the sofa with her grandson

persos.desc: grandson around 8, dinosaur t-shirt, holding a toy dinosaur
grandmother in her 80s, wrinkled face, purple headwrap, big glasses

dialogue: Mamie, tu as vu les dinosaures ?
Oui. C'est ton grand-père qui les nourrissait.
jeu: The grandson shows his toy dinosaur. The grandmother answers proudly as if it were obvious.

lieu: family kitchen in Abobo, Abidjan, grandmother stirring a big pot of sauce, granddaughter on her phone

persos.desc: granddaughter in her 20s, crop top, staring at her phone while stirring a pot
persos.pose: stirring with one hand, phone in the other

persos.nom: the grandmother with the wooden spoon
persos.desc: grandmother in her 70s, green wax dress, headwrap, wooden spoon

dialogue: Mamie, pourquoi ta sauce est toujours meilleure ?
Parce que moi, je ne cuisine pas avec le téléphone.
jeu: The granddaughter asks without looking up from her phone. The grandmother points the spoon at the phone.

lieu: front gate of a house in Cocody, Abidjan, a taxi unloading six huge suitcases

persos.desc: mother-in-law in her 60s, giant red headwrap, sunglasses, handbag, sweet smile
son-in-law in his 30s, white shirt, staring at the pile of suitcases
persos.pose: staring at the six suitcases, horrified

dialogue: Je viens passer deux jours seulement.
Deux jours… de quelle année ?
jeu: The mother-in-law announces sweetly. The son-in-law counts the six huge suitcases with his finger, horrified.

lieu: living room in Marcory, Abidjan, family meeting before a wedding, sofa and armchairs

persos.desc: bride's mother in her 50s, elegant blue boubou, gold jewelry
future son-in-law in his 30s, beige suit, relaxed smile

dialogue: Mon fils, ma fille ne sait pas cuisiner.
Pas grave, Tantie. Moi, je ne sais pas payer.
jeu: The mother confesses with embarrassment. The future son-in-law answers with a relaxed smile and a thumbs-up.

lieu: courtyard of a family compound in Anyama near Abidjan during a traditional dowry ceremony, elders on plastic chairs under a mango tree, bottles of gin and folded wax cloths on a mat

persos.nom: the bride's father with the kente
persos.desc: proud bride's father in his 60s, kente cloth draped over one shoulder, walking stick, gold rings
persos.pose: sitting on a big chair like a king, raising one finger

persos.nom: the suitor in the cream suit
persos.desc: slim suitor in his 20s, cream suit, red bow tie, folder of papers on his knees
persos.pose: kneeling politely on the mat, one eyebrow raised

persos.nom: the bride peeking from the door
persos.desc: bride in her 20s, elegant orange-and-gold wax dress with matching headwrap
persos.pose: peeking from behind a door in the background, smiling proudly

dialogue: Ma fille a fait l'université. La dot : cinq millions.
Elle a eu le diplôme ?
…Trois millions.
Elle sait cuisiner ?
Prends-la gratuitement, mon fils !
jeu: The father announces the price proudly. The suitor asks calmly; the father coughs and lowers the price. At the second question the father panics and waves the price away with both hands.
chute: The bride, peeking from the door, drops her jaw in outrage while her father eagerly waves her toward the suitor. End on a close-up of the bride's outraged face staring into the camera.

lieu: living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, father reading a newspaper, daughter standing next to him

persos.desc: daughter in her 20s, pink dress, hands clasped
strict father in his 50s, brown boubou, reading glasses, newspaper

dialogue: Papa, mon copain veut venir se présenter.
Dis-lui d'apporter son CV… et un sac de riz.
jeu: The daughter announces shyly. The father lowers his newspaper slowly and lists his conditions.

lieu: street in Abobo, Abidjan, a skinny big brother rolling up his sleeves, his little sister pointing at a huge bodybuilder

persos.desc: very skinny young man in his 20s, tank top, rolling up his sleeves aggressively
little sister around 12, school uniform, pointing behind him
huge bodybuilder in his 30s, enormous muscles, tight black t-shirt, arms crossed

dialogue: Qui a insulté ma petite sœur ? Montre-le-moi !
Ah… Grand frère, merci d'avoir corrigé ma sœur. Elle parle trop.
jeu: The skinny brother shouts aggressively. The sister points at the bodybuilder. The brother turns, sees the muscles, and instantly bows politely.

lieu: living room in Port-Bouet, Abidjan, father shouting at the TV during a football match, son on the sofa

persos.desc: boy around 10, orange jersey, sitting on the sofa

persos.nom: the father shouting at the TV
persos.desc: father in his 40s, orange-white-green face paint, standing in front of the TV with his arms up

dialogue: Papa, pourquoi tu cries contre la télé ?
Parce que l'entraîneur ne m'écoute pas !
jeu: The father shouts instructions at the TV. The son asks calmly. The father answers furious, pointing at the screen.

lieu: neighborhood football field in Yopougon, Abidjan, dusty pitch, wooden goalposts with a torn net

persos.nom: the goalkeeper with the big gloves
persos.desc: chubby goalkeeper in his 20s, oversized gloves, yellow jersey, dusty
coach in his 50s, tracksuit, whistle, clipboard

dialogue: Coach, pourquoi tu me remplaces ?
Onze buts, mon fils. Même le filet est fatigué.
jeu: The goalkeeper protests. The coach points at the torn net hanging sadly behind him.

lieu: busy chicken grill maquis in Yopougon, Abidjan, smoke, braised chickens, plastic tables

persos.desc: grill man in his 40s, apron, chef hat, tongs in hand
broke young man in his 20s, old t-shirt, eyes closed, sniffing the smoke with delight

dialogue: Le poulet braisé, c'est combien ?
Cinq mille.
Et l'odeur ? Je reste juste à côté.
jeu: The customer asks. The grill man answers. The customer sits next to the grill, eyes closed, breathing in the smoke.

lieu: ATM in front of a bank in Adjame, Abidjan, a man reading the screen, his friend beside him

persos.desc: man in his 30s, blue shirt, bank card in hand, desperate face
friend in his 30s, white cap, laughing

dialogue: La machine dit : solde insuffisant !
Même la machine te connaît maintenant.
jeu: The man reads the screen in despair. His friend pats his shoulder and laughs.

lieu: street in Treichville, Abidjan, two friends in front of a kiosk

persos.desc: young man in his 20s, flashy shirt, sunglasses, hand out
young man in his 20s, grey t-shirt, hands in his pockets

dialogue: Prête-moi dix mille. Je te rembourse lundi.
Quel lundi ?
Choisis. Il y en a beaucoup.
jeu: The friend asks with confidence. The other raises an eyebrow. The first spreads his arms generously.

lieu: wedding reception buffet in Cocody, Abidjan, long table with big dishes of rice, chicken and attieke

persos.desc: aunt in her 50s, gold boubou, hand on her hip

persos.nom: the uncle with the huge plate
persos.desc: uncle in his 60s, white boubou, holding a plate piled very high with food

dialogue: Tonton, c'est ta cinquième assiette !
Non, c'est la même. Je la remplis seulement.
jeu: The aunt points at his plate. The uncle keeps adding food and answers innocently.

lieu: bedroom in Marcory, Abidjan, birthday balloons, a girl with her eyes closed waiting for a gift

persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, party dress, birthday crown, eyes closed, hands held out
young man in his 20s, empty hands, nervous smile
persos.pose: standing in front of her with empty hands

dialogue: Chéri, je veux un gros téléphone !
Ferme les yeux.
Maintenant, imagine.
jeu: The girl asks excitedly and closes her eyes. The boyfriend waves his empty hands in front of her and whispers.

lieu: bedroom at night in Koumassi, Abidjan, double bed with a colorful bedspread, moonlight through the window, door half-open to a dark living room

persos.desc: scrawny husband in his 30s, striped pyjamas, holding a wooden broom like a weapon
persos.pose: standing on the bed flexing his thin arms, boasting

persos.desc: wife in her 30s, pink nightgown, hair in a satin bonnet, holding the blanket
persos.pose: sitting up in bed, listening, worried

dialogue: Un voleur qui rentre ici, je le corrige !
Chéri… il y a quelqu'un au salon.
Dis-lui que je ne suis pas là.
jeu: The husband boasts and swings the broom. The wife whispers, pointing at the dark door. The husband instantly dives under the bed and answers in a tiny voice.
chute: Only the husband's trembling eyes are visible under the bed while the broom rolls out by itself. End on a close-up of the wife's unimpressed face staring into the camera.

lieu: primary school classroom in Yopougon, Abidjan, sentence written on the chalkboard

persos.nom: the teacher in the green dress
persos.desc: female teacher in her 40s, green wax dress, glasses, chalk
pupil around 10, white shirt, standing up

dialogue: Conjugue le verbe manger au futur.
Je mangerai… si papa est payé.
jeu: The teacher asks. The pupil stands up and answers very seriously, then sits down with a sigh.

lieu: shared courtyard in Koumassi, Abidjan, father and son sitting on a bench in front of a small shop

persos.desc: teenage son around 17, heart eyes, hands on his heart
father in his 50s, kaftan, calculating on his fingers, sly smile

dialogue: Papa, je suis amoureux de la fille du boutiquier.
Bravo, mon fils ! On aura enfin du crédit.
jeu: The son announces dreamily. The father calculates on his fingers, delighted, and hugs his son.

lieu: living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, a teacher's note on the table, father and son

persos.desc: boy around 10, school uniform, holding the teacher's note
father in his 40s, glasses, white shirt, proud smile fading

dialogue: Papa, le devoir que tu as fait pour moi…
Oui ?
Le maître dit que tu redoubles.
jeu: The boy announces with embarrassment. The father smiles proudly, then freezes.

lieu: inside an orange Abidjan taxi stuck in a gigantic traffic jam on a bridge over the Ebrie lagoon, cars everywhere, hot afternoon

persos.desc: relaxed taxi driver in his 40s, cap, toothpick in his mouth, hands on the wheel

persos.nom: the passenger with the giant beard
persos.desc: passenger in the front seat with an absurdly long white beard reaching his knees, office suit, briefcase
young woman in the back seat, bright turquoise-and-yellow wax dress, big hoop earrings, short braids, holding a newborn baby

dialogue: On arrive bientôt, Tonton. C'est juste le pont.
Quand je suis monté, je n'avais pas de barbe !
Et moi, je n'étais même pas enceinte !
jeu: The driver reassures calmly. The passenger shows his giant beard. The woman in the back seat lifts her baby angrily.
chute: The driver honks once, the car moves forward a few centimeters and stops again. End on a close-up of the bearded passenger's desperate face staring into the camera.

lieu: front door of a house in Treichville, Abidjan, father looking at his son's ripped jeans

persos.nom: the father pointing at the jeans
persos.desc: father in his 50s, brown kaftan, pointing at the ripped jeans
son around 18, very ripped jeans, sunglasses, gold chain

dialogue: Tu vas où avec ce pantalon déchiré ?
C'est la mode, papa !
Moi aussi j'étais à la mode : on était pauvres.
jeu: The father points at the jeans. The son poses proudly. The father answers with a sad nostalgic face.

lieu: backyard in Abobo, Abidjan, father cutting his son's hair with a cooking pot on his head

persos.desc: boy around 8, sitting on a stool with an upside-down cooking pot on his head
persos.pose: sitting with the pot on his head, worried

persos.desc: father in his 40s, singlet, big scissors, confident
persos.pose: cutting around the pot with big scissors

dialogue: Papa, le coiffeur, c'est mille francs seulement !
Assieds-toi. Papa a une marmite et des ciseaux.
jeu: The boy protests with the pot on his head. The father cuts around the pot with big scissors, confident.

lieu: dining room in Marcory, Abidjan, husband looking at a plate of very black sauce

persos.desc: husband in his 30s, white shirt, holding a spoon of black sauce
wife in her 30s, apron, headwrap, proud smile

dialogue: Chérie, c'est quoi cette sauce noire ?
La recette de ta maman !
Ah… c'est pour ça que j'ai quitté la maison.
jeu: The husband inspects the sauce. The wife answers proudly. The husband slowly puts the spoon down.

lieu: traffic jam in Adjame, Abidjan, a little boy selling candy between the cars, a man in a car

persos.desc: little boy around 10, tray of candy on his head, cheeky smile
persos.pose: holding out candy at the car window

persos.desc: man in his 40s, suit, sunglasses, inside a car with the window down

dialogue: Tonton, achète mes bonbons !
Je n'ai pas de monnaie.
Pas de problème. J'accepte aussi les gros billets.
jeu: The boy holds out candy. The man refuses. The boy answers with a cheeky smile and holds out his hand.

lieu: front gate of a house in Koumassi, Abidjan, a creditor knocking, a little girl answering the door, the mother hiding behind the curtain

persos.desc: creditor in her 50s, purple headwrap, notebook of debts

persos.nom: the little girl at the door
persos.desc: little girl around 6, yellow dress, braids

persos.nom: the mother hiding behind the curtain
persos.desc: mother in her 30s, hiding behind a curtain, only her eyes visible

dialogue: Ta maman est là ?
Elle dit de vous dire qu'elle n'est pas là.
jeu: The creditor asks. The little girl answers innocently. The creditor looks at the curtain where the mother hides.

lieu: neighborhood shop in Abobo, Abidjan, bread baguettes in a basket, shopkeeper behind the counter

persos.desc: customer in her 30s, orange wax dress, holding a coin
shopkeeper in his 40s, white skullcap, holding a baguette

dialogue: Hier le pain était à cent francs !
Oui. Mais il a dormi ici. Il paie le loyer.
jeu: The customer protests. The shopkeeper pats the bread tenderly and answers calmly.
